answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every new identity to draw nectar from a shared orchard of locked stakes put up by distinct established peers. Each sponsor bonds a non-transferable claim that forms one strand in a trellis of mutual countersignatures. The nth fake identity must recruit n fresh%2C non-kin sponsors whose earlier bonds are already exhausted%3B the clean sponsor pool shrinks%2C so marginal cost rises superlinearly and any detected clone burns the entire sponsor path.
